# Specify a Power Automate Flow

Create a flow specification before proposing implementation: name, purpose, owner, trigger/conditions, input/output contract, actions, connections/references, environment variables, exception handling, retries, concurrency, monitoring, test cases, security, deployment, and rollback. Use no embedded secrets. Keep validation local/mocked; do not create, modify, enable, disable, publish, delete, or resubmit a live flow.
